summary: File stream seek with mode-flag validation. Reads the mode flags at this+0xC; if (flags & 0x83) is zero or the seek origin a3 exceeds 2 it sets the TLS error slot to 22 (EINVAL) via TLSOffsetGetter and returns -1. Otherwise it clears bit 0x10 of the flags, optionally (a3==1) adds sub_58C824(a1) to the requested offset for a relative seek, flushes buffered writes with BufferFlushWrite, conditionally resets the +0x18 field to 512 or clears the low two flag bits, performs the seek via sub_595F11(this+0x10 handle, offset), and returns 0 on success / -1 on failure. Called by ThreadSafeWrapper.

local_names.v4: seek origin forwarded to sub_595F11 (forced to 0 when a3==1)

operations.description: Proceed only if (flags & 0x83) != 0 and a3 <= 2; otherwise the error path writes 22 into the TLS slot returned by TLSOffsetGetter() and returns -1.
Clear bit 0x10 of the flags (mask 0xEF) and store back to a1[3].
When a3 == 1, call sub_58C824(a1) and add its returned value to the requested offset a2 (relative-seek position query); force v4 = 0.
Flush pending buffered writes before seeking: BufferFlushWrite(a1).

Re-read flags at +0xC: if (flags & 0x80) == 0 and (flags & 1) and (flags & 8) and (flags & 0x400) == 0, set a1[6] (+0x18) = 512; otherwise (bit 0x80 set) clear the low two bits (mask 0xFC) and store back.
Perform the seek: v7 = sub_595F11(a1[4] handle at +0x10, a2, SHIDWORD(a2), v4).
If (v8 & v7) != 0xFFFFFFFF return 0 (success); otherwise fall through to the failure return.
Failure paths return -1 (including the TLS-22 guard failure path).
